### 🟢 Approval recommended The supplied review status identifies no active issues remaining in the polling changes and accompanying tests, fixtures, documentation, and version updates. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This pull request updates Codex polling to count only unresolved threads opened by Codex, adds an offline replay harness with fixtures and tests, documents the revised exit-code behavior, and bumps the Git plugin version to 3.11.3. **Changes:** - Filter Codex findings while retaining the total unresolved-thread count for pull-request state. - Add replay, recording, fixtures, and tests for polling scenarios. - Update Codex documentation and synchronize plugin versions. - **Moderate issue:** `record-poll` does not propagate recorder or observation failures, allowing incomplete fixtures to appear successful. This pull request requires changes. | File | Summary | |---|---| | `tests/​address-pr-feedback/​record-poll` | Records poll-script GitHub responses as replay fixtures. | | `tests/​address-pr-feedback/​poll-codex.test.ts` | Adds regression tests for Codex polling behavior. | | `tests/​address-pr-feedback/​fixtures/​codex-clean.json` | Provides the recorded clean-review fixture. | | `tests/​address-pr-feedback/​fake-gh.mjs` | Replays and records mapped `gh` calls with fixture snapshots. | | `plugins/​git/​skills/​address-pr-feedback/​scripts/​poll-codex.sh` | Counts and dumps only unresolved Codex-authored threads. | | `plugins/​git/​skills/​address-pr-feedback/​references/​GITHUB-CODEX.md` | Documents the narrower clean and finding exit-code semantics. | | `plugins/​git/​plugin.json` | Bumps the portable Git plugin version to 3.11.3. | | `plugins/​git/​.claude-plugin/​plugin.json` | Keeps the Claude extension version aligned at 3.11.3. |
Review effort: Lite
